title: リアルな動物（図鑑風）
subject_en: Realistic natural-history illustration style of animals, each ONE animal full body, centred, accurate proportions and natural colours, soft shading. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 犬、ハムスター、カエル、魚、昆虫など、図鑑のようなリアルな動物12点。理科の資料や自由研究、解説スライドに。
items: a golden hamster holding a seed
a green tree frog on a leaf
a swallowtail butterfly with open wings
